title: Software company or B2B service (no local pack)
basis: Recalled general knowledge, 2026-10-22; hosts not re-fetched (UNVERIFIED). Review platforms are among the sources AI engines quote for 'best X software' questions; read the research-ai captures for the client's category to see which ones.

domainTypes.note: review platform; website field; reviews matter most
same owner family as GetApp and Software Advice
launch once, with a real maker
company facts that feed other databases
organisation page and the open-source repos
app directory page if there is an integration

patterns.why: a newsletter that features tools and guests
an integration marketplace or partner directory

angles: Claim the review-platform profiles first (G2, Capterra, TrustRadius); then ask real customers for reviews through the platform's own invitation tool.
Publish a data study, benchmark or free tool from the product's own numbers; reporters and newsletters link to original data.
List the product in the integration marketplace of every tool it works with; each page links back.
Ask customers for a case-study page they host or share; their site links to yours.
Guest on three podcasts or newsletters the buyers follow; give one concrete lesson.
Get on curated lists (awesome lists, 'tools for X' roundups) by contacting the maintainer with a clear fit.
avoid: Incentivised or fake reviews; platforms ban them and ban the vendor.
Comment, forum and Q&A drops with links; community members spot and flag them.
Buying guest posts from link-seller marketplaces.
